name: Burning Block (Wooden Box)
description: A movable wooden box that can be burned to reveal its contents.

fields.name: Item Drop Option
fields.description: Determines which item the box drops when destroyed.

1.name: Red Force Gem
1.description: Drops a Red Force Gem worth 20 Force Gems.

2.name: Large Green Force Gem
2.description: Drops a large green Force Gem worth 100 Force Gems.

3.name: Large Purple Force Gem
3.description: Drops a large purple Force Gem worth 300 Force Gems.
